name: folder-access-bookmarks-grant-and-refuse-like-the-swift-engine
description: The Mac app hands folder access over as bookmarks. A grant whose bookmark doesn't resolve is refused with folder_access_denied and a valid one is accepted silently; a scan whose bookmark doesn't resolve, or resolves to another folder, is refused with folder_access_denied and an empty scanComplete and catalogues nothing; a scan with the root's own bookmark, or with none (Developer ID builds), catalogues the tree.
